title: First pillar of Iman – Amantu billahi
intro: “Amantu billahi” – I believe in Allah. What this belief means and how we come to know Allah.

learn.html: It is the duty of every Muslim to believe in Allah (SWT). Believing in Allah means believing with our heart, and saying with our tongue, that there is no god except Allah.
Allah is the Lord and the Creator of everything. Only He deserves to be believed in and worshipped, and we pray and bow down to Him alone. He has 99 names, and His own name is Allah.

learn.text: So know, [O Muhammad], that there is no deity except Allah
How do we come to know Allah?

learn.html: There are many ways, but two are the most important:

learn.title: 📖 Through His revelation
learn.html: Allah (SWT) revealed the Qur’an. In it are the ayat we should read and think about.

learn.title: 🌍 Through what He created
learn.html: Allah created nature, and it is full of clear signs that He exists: the human being, planet Earth, the sky, plants, animals and everything else we see.
We believe in Allah (SWT) through His attributes (sifat). They are divided into two groups:

items: As-sifat adh-dhatiyyah – the attributes of Allah’s being
As-sifat ath-thubutiyyah – the attributes of Allah’s perfection

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: The human being is Allah’s most perfect and most complete creation.
Many ayat of the Qur’an speak about Allah’s existence and His Oneness. Surah Al-Ikhlas is all about it:

learn.text: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent."

learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “Allah has ninety-nine names, one hundred less one. Whoever learns them will enter Jannah.” (Bukhari)

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: The name Allah is mentioned in the Qur’an 2,698 times.

practice.title: Signs of Allah around us
practice.prompt: Tap everything that Allah created, then tap Check.

options.why: People make idols with their hands – an idol cannot create anything. Only Allah is the Creator.

questions.q: What does believing in Allah mean?
options: Believing with the heart and saying with the tongue that there is no god except Allah
Only saying it with the tongue

questions.q: What are the two most important ways to come to know Allah?
options: Through His revelation (the Qur’an) and through what He created
We cannot know Him at all

questions.q: How many names does Allah have?
Which surah is all about Allah’s Oneness?

options: Allah is One, He neither begets nor is born, and nothing is equal to Him
